title: Conditional Expressions
scenario: A conditional expression chooses one of two values: condition ? true_value : false_value. Use the environment variable to pick a production flag and a log-retention period.
constraints: Set log retention to 30 days in production and 7 otherwise.
Derive both values in the locals block.

focus.title: Add the conditional locals
focus.todo: Compare the environment and choose retention values.

hints.why: HCL is the language Terraform evaluates. Small syntax mistakes here turn into confusing plan errors later, so slow, deliberate practice pays off.
hints.what: Complete the marked region in `main.tf`. The work is inside `locals`. Compare the environment and choose retention values. Use the visible constraints as the checklist for names, values and references before you run the tests.
hints.when: Reach for this whenever you add a new block or argument by hand rather than copying generated code.
hints.how: Open `main.tf` and work only inside `locals`. Use this code shape: is_production; log_retention. Use the already-declared references instead of hardcoded values: `var.environment`, `local.is_production`. Keep the block header and braces, indent nested blocks by two spaces, and add one argument or nested block at a time. Run the tests after each small change so the first failure points at the next name to fix.
